# Northwestern University WCAS Faculty

> Faculty directory and research resources for the Weinberg College of Arts and Sciences at Northwestern University, featuring faculty contacts, research participation opportunities, and departmental information.

This site provides faculty information, research participation opportunities, and departmental resources for Northwestern University's Weinberg College of Arts and Sciences. It serves as a hub for connecting students and researchers with faculty members and ongoing studies across disciplines including neuroscience and economics.

## Key Topics

- Northwestern University
- Cognitive Neuroscience Lab
- Department of Economics
- Research participation
- Experimental studies
- Sleep research
- Lucid dreaming
- Faculty contact
- Participant recruitment
- Evanston, Illinois
- Arthur Andersen Hall
- Sheridan Road

## Research Participation

- [Cognitive Neuroscience Lab Research Studies](https://faculty.wcas.northwestern.edu/paller/apply/): Research participation application for Cognitive Neuroscience Lab studies involving sleep research, lucid dreaming, and experimental cognitive research
